title: 第216章 信奉我佛可得到一切第215章 大刚灭菩萨我佛才是真佛
content_zh:
“坠入魔道的是你们，而不是我。”幽尘行者冷冷开口。
他指着大刚灭菩萨无情，丝毫不给他们面子，跟着他们的佛祖，最后得到了什么？
答案很显然，什么都没有得到，只会得到所谓的我佛慈悲，还有就是阿弥陀佛，然后呢，实际性的奖励没有，什么都没有，让你干活的时候，就拼命用你，让你像是牛马一样干活，哪怕是牛马，还知道给几口吃的。
而他们呢，什么都没有，资源没有，功法没有，神通也没有，什么都需要依靠自己去感悟，那么，他们还感恩佛门什么？继续跟着他们，努力了那么久，最后不如人家弟子一个屁。
既然如此，他不伺候了，谁爱伺候谁伺候去，什么众生平等，呵呵，那不过是忽悠你的一番话罢了，实际上，此地比谁都要歧视，你不是他们的弟子，得不到他们的重用，现实就是这么离谱，就是这么残酷。
枯土尊者跟着开口：“大刚灭菩萨，还有清明菩萨，你们扪心自问，他们给你什么了？和金刚佛子比，你们做的事情足够多了，比起他要多很多，功劳苦劳都有，远不是金刚佛子能比的，而他，什么都没做，却能够得到你们一辈子都得不到的东西。”
“功法，资源，神通，还是各种丹药，他都有，而且还不少，用不完，而你们呢，随便给两枚丹药打发了，有时候，丹药都懒得给你们，就给你们一句话，何等可悲，何等……歧视。”
“如果我是你们，我会立刻背叛他们，还跟着他们做什么？这样的佛祖，不值得追随。”
枯土尊者伸手，继续开始他的言语诱惑，那声音，回荡在他们的灵魂之中，枯土尊者想要说服他们，想要让其他的弟子心动，然后黑气趁机进入他们的内心，从而侵蚀他们的内心，让这一批弟子彻底成为了他们的人。
这些人，很多人都心动了，他们都受到了不公平的待遇，整个佛门灵山，很多人的待遇都一样，他们是敢怒不敢言，无论比什么，他们都可以，只要让他们心服口服就行，若是你无法让他们服气，对不起，你不配拥有更多的资源。
任何门派都一样，都是依靠拳头打上去的，你战胜了我，我服气。
但是，佛门不一样，比如金刚佛子，依靠的是须弥佛祖一步步喂养上去的，从一开始他所得到的东西就是其他人一辈子都得不到的，何等可笑。
他们努力了这么久，最后得到了这么一句话，当真是可笑。
“行了，不要废话了，贫僧是不会被你们所诱惑的。”大刚灭菩萨冷声呵斥，不会相信他们的话，或者说，他不愿意去相信这种话，因为他知道眼前这些人不长久，跟着他们，反而会让自己陷入麻烦之中。
除非，眼前这些人让他看到了希望，很显然，没有。
不过呢，他们所说的很有道理，佛门灵山，已经肮脏不堪了，说是平等，实际上，比任何地方都要歧视。
清明菩萨没有说话，而是等着大刚灭菩萨的反应，她很想知道这个菩萨是怎么想的？是想要背叛呢，还是继续坚定拥护须弥佛祖呢？
佛门的三位佛祖都一样，还好的是黄眉佛祖死了，被灵心佛子取代了，这才变得不一样。
“或许，大刚灭菩萨可以拉拢一下，灵心佛子肯定很喜欢多一尊强者。”清明菩萨内心暗道。
这个人很显然心动了，也很显然想要离开他所在的范围，和他一样命运的人可不少，这些人，都需要一个公平而已，要的可不多。

结果，很残酷。
“就让这些小老鼠继续忽悠他们，撼动他们的心，不过别说，这些小老鼠是真的能说，一身实力提升得很快，难道黑莲如此逆天，能够让他们迅速掌控不属于自己的力量？”
这种力量掌控，需要代价的，而她们却没有付出代价，这就是奇怪的地方。
十分奇怪，也十分骇人。
不可能无缘无故得到力量，必须要付出什么，可能他们还不知道付出了什么，他们的修为提升固然令人震惊，不少弟子都心动了，那些弟子一旦心动，立刻被黑气侵蚀，成为了黑气的一部分。
“大刚灭菩萨，清明菩萨，你们不如皈依我佛，以你们的修为和实力，肯定得到我佛的重用，我佛会让你们修为迅速提升，你们还考虑什么？我等一起动手，拿下金刚佛子，献祭给我佛，我佛会看到你们的诚意，从而降下奖励。”
“来吧，动手吧，拿下金刚佛子。”
枯土尊者还在继续忽悠，忽悠他们这些人，能够忽悠一个就很完美了。
他知道，不太可能，这些菩萨可都是人精，不会轻易改变立场，也不会轻易离开。
“住嘴！”金刚佛子怒喝一声，指着枯土尊者他们，冷冷道：“你们这些小老鼠太放肆了。”
当着自己的面，挖走属于自己的人，他们，太过分了。
士可杀，不可辱。
金刚佛子可不能让他们被迷惑，从而对自己动手，那两尊菩萨可不弱，一旦叛变，他将会变得很危险，其他的那些弟子叛变无所谓，他都可以处理。
“大刚灭菩萨，清明菩萨，你们不要相信他们的鬼话，这些人，鬼话连篇，他们嘴里所谓的佛，不过是一尊魔头罢了，可不是什么佛。”
“一尊魔，也敢自称为佛，我看你是找死。”
枯土尊者死死盯着金刚佛子，杀气腾腾道：“胆敢羞辱我佛，你该死，金刚佛子，我佛可是佛门伟大之佛，可不是尔等能比的。”
“见到我佛，你自然会明白，我佛，才是佛门灵山真正的佛。”
“哈哈哈。”金刚佛子闻言哈哈大笑，他指着三人，轻蔑道：“你们真懂得给自己脸上贴金，什么真正的佛，魔头就是魔头，还敢自称为佛，当真是可笑。”
“枯土尊者，你们背后那一尊佛，只不过是一只小老鼠罢了，被我佛门封印万年，如今突破封印，也就你们这些废物能相信他的鬼话，你们可真是废物。”
“今日，本佛子必杀你们。”

“尔等，受死吧。”
金刚佛子指着他们，杀意凝聚到了极点，他很清楚，这些人必须杀干净了，不能让他们继续忽悠自己的人。

content_en:
"It's you who fell into the devil's path, not me." Youchen Walker said coldly.
He pointed at the Buddha who was ruthless and followed them without giving them any face. What did he get in the end?
The answer is obviously, you will get nothing, you will only get the so-called compassion of Buddha, and Amitabha. Then, there will be no practical rewards, nothing. When you are asked to work, you will be used as hard as you can, making you work like an ox or horse. Even if you are an ox or horse, you still know how many mouthfuls to eat.
As for them, they have nothing, no resources, no skills, no magical powers. They have to rely on themselves to understand everything. So, what do they have to be grateful to Buddhism for? I continued to follow them and worked hard for so long, but in the end I was no better than their disciples.
In this case, he won't serve you anymore. Whoever wants to serve you will serve him. All living beings are equal. Haha, that's just a lie to you. In fact, this place is more discriminatory than anyone else. You are not their disciple and you cannot be valued by them. The reality is so outrageous and cruel.
Venerable Kutu then spoke: "Bodhisattva Mahagirvana and Bodhisattva Qingming, ask yourselves, what did they give you? Compared with Vajra Buddha, you have done enough things, much more than him. You have all the credit and hard work, which is far beyond what Vajra Buddha can compare with. But he has done nothing, but he can get things that you will never get in your life."
"He has all kinds of skills, resources, magical powers, and various elixirs, and there are quite a lot of them. He can't use them all. And you, just give two elixirs away. Sometimes, the elixirs are too lazy to give you, so they just give you one sentence. How sad, how...discriminatory."
"If I were you, I would betray them immediately. Why should I follow them? Such a Buddha is not worth following."
Lord Kutu stretched out his hand and continued to seduce his words. The voice echoed in their souls. Lord Kutu wanted to persuade them and make the other disciples' hearts flutter. Then the black energy took the opportunity to enter their hearts, thereby eroding their hearts and making these disciples completely theirs.
Many of these people are moved. They have been treated unfairly. In the entire Buddhist Lingshan Mountain, many people are treated the same. They dare to be angry but dare not speak out. No matter what the comparison is, they can do it, as long as they are convinced. If you can't convince them, I'm sorry, you don't deserve more resources.
It’s the same with any sect, they all rely on fists to win. If you beat me, I’m convinced.
However, Buddhism is different. For example, Vajra Buddha is fed step by step by Sumeru Buddha. What he gets from the beginning is something that others cannot get in their lifetime. How ridiculous.
It's really ridiculous that they worked hard for so long and finally got such a sentence.
"Okay, stop talking nonsense. The poor monk will not be tempted by you." Dagongni Bodhisattva coldly scolded him. He would not believe what they said. In other words, he was unwilling to believe such words because he knew that these people in front of him would not last long. If he followed them, he would get into trouble.
Unless these people in front of him gave him hope, obviously, they didn't.
However, what they said makes sense. Lingshan Mountain in Buddhism is already filthy. They say it is equality, but in fact, it is more discriminatory than anywhere else.
Qingming Bodhisattva did not speak, but waited for the reaction of Mahavatar Bodhisattva. She wanted to know what this Bodhisattva thought? Do you want to betray, or continue to firmly support Sumeru Buddha?
The three Buddhas of Buddhism are all the same. Fortunately, the Yellow Eyebrow Buddha died and was replaced by the Spiritual Heart Buddha, which made them different.
"Perhaps Dagongni Bodhisattva can win over him. Lingxin Buddha would definitely like to have another strong man." Qingming Bodhisattva secretly thought in his heart.
This person was obviously moved and wanted toThere are many people with the same fate as him who want to leave the area where he is. These people all need fairness, not much.
The result was brutal.
"Let these little mice continue to fool them and shake their hearts. But don't say it, these little mice can really say that their strength has improved very quickly. Could it be that Black Lotus is so defiant that it can allow them to quickly control power that does not belong to them?"
This kind of power control comes at a price, but they didn't pay the price. This is the strange thing.
Very strange and very scary.
It is impossible to gain power for no reason. You have to pay something. Maybe they don't know what they paid. The improvement of their cultivation is certainly shocking. Many disciples are moved. Once those disciples are moved, they are immediately eroded by the black energy and become part of the black energy.
"Great Gangannihilation Bodhisattva and Qingming Bodhisattva, you might as well take refuge in my Buddha. With your cultivation and strength, I will definitely put you in my Buddha's care. My Buddha will quickly improve your cultivation. What else are you thinking about? We will work together to take down the Vajra Buddha's son and sacrifice it to my Buddha. My Buddha will see your sincerity and give you a reward."
"Come on, let's take down the Vajra Buddha."
Lord Kutu continues to fool people like them. It would be perfect if he could fool just one of them.
He knew that it was unlikely. These Bodhisattvas were all human beings and would not change their stance or leave easily.
"Shut up!" Vajra Buddha shouted angrily, pointed at Venerable Kutu and the others, and said coldly: "You little mice are too presumptuous."
They went too far by poaching their own people in front of them.
Scholars can be killed but not humiliated.
Vajra Buddha cannot let them be deceived and take action against him. Those two Bodhisattvas are not weak. Once they rebel, he will become very dangerous. It doesn't matter if the other disciples rebel, he can handle them.
"Dagongni Bodhisattva and Qingming Bodhisattva, don't believe their lies. These people are telling lies. The so-called Buddha they say is just a demon, not a Buddha."
"A demon dares to call himself Buddha. I think you are seeking death."
Venerable Kutu stared at Vajra Buddha, and said with murderous intent: "You dare to humiliate me, Buddha, and you deserve to die, Vajra Buddha. I am a great Buddha in Buddhism, and I am not comparable to you."
"When you see my Buddha, you will naturally understand that I, the Buddha, am the real Buddha in the Buddhist Lingshan Mountain."
"Hahaha." King Kong Buddha laughed loudly when he heard this. He pointed at the three of them and said contemptuously: "You really know how to put gold on your faces. What is the real Buddha? The devil is the devil. You dare to call yourself a Buddha. It is really ridiculous."
"Venerable Kutu, that Buddha behind you is just a little mouse. It has been sealed by our Buddhist sect for thousands of years. Now that the seal has been broken, only you trash can believe his lies. You are really trash."
"Today, this Buddha will kill you."
"You guys, just die."
Vajra Buddha pointed at them, his murderous intent concentrated to the extreme. He knew very well that these people must be killed, and he could not let them continue to deceive his own people.
